instruction:
Fix `packages/catalog-model/src/entity/policies/FieldFormatEntityPolicy.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. yarn build:api-reports fails the package's no-warnings gate ("Error: The API Report for packages/catalog-model is not allowed to have warnings"). The generated packages/catalog-model/report.api.md now carries exactly one warning line, introduced by this run, on the enforce member of FieldFormatEntityPolicy:

  // Warning: (ae-unresolved-link) The @link reference could not be resolved: The package "@backstage/catalog-model" does not have an export "Error"

The cause is in the TSDoc block added to the enforce method at line 61 of this file:

  * @throws An {@link Error} on the first validation failure, naming the failing

{@link Error} points at the global JavaScript Error constructor, which is not an export of @backstage/catalog-model, so API Extractor cannot resolve it. A {@link ...} in this package may only target an export of this package (e.g. {@link Entity}) or a URL ({@link https://...}).

Fix: in the @throws text of enforce, refer to the error in plain prose with no {@link} wrapper around Error — write the word Error (or `Error`) as plain text instead of {@link Error}. Change nothing else: keep the rest of the @throws sentence and every other line of the block exactly as it is, keep the tag order (description, @remarks, release tag, @param, @throws), keep @param entity - with its hyphen, add no release tag to this member (it is a member of a documented class), and do not alter the copyright header or its year. This is a comment-only change; the method body must not change.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.

## Answer
Return ONLY a JSON object {"path": "packages/catalog-model/src/entity/policies/FieldFormatEntityPolicy.ts", "edits": [{"search": "<text copied exactly from the current text>", "replace": "<its replacement>"}]} with no other text. Each search must appear exactly once in the current text; the edits apply in order.
If the file does not exist yet, or the change rewrites most of it, return {"path": "packages/catalog-model/src/entity/policies/FieldFormatEntityPolicy.ts", "content": "<the complete file>"} instead.
